title: Order matters
prompt: The first value passed in goes into the first parameter, the second into the second. The starter subtracts them the wrong way round. Fix it so subtract_in_order(10, 3) is 7.
starter:
func subtract_in_order(a, b):
	return b - a
hints: Look at subtract_in_order(10, 3): which parameter holds 10?
Swap the two names in the return line.
solution:
func subtract_in_order(a, b):
	return a - b
